data.narrative:
GHGSat is a Series D-stage space technology company that has raised $67M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 4 private peers in the Space & Aerospace sector at Series C–D stages, including Apex Space ($2.3B), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B), Sierra Space ($8.0B), and Skyryse ($1.1B), supplemented by reference to 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 25.3x price-to-sales.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier to a $500M total-raised proxy, yielding $750M. Peer-median anchoring across the 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces $1.9B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of revenue disclosure typical of private companies.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $638M (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median of $1.3B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding GHGSat's revenue trajectory and relative competitive positioning within a heterogeneous peer set. The $8.0B Sierra Space valuation, while in the reference set, appears to reflect distinct stage and capital access dynamics and should be weighted cautiously in synthesis.
